subject: RE: Renewal capacity forecast — usage-driven GPU add
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@havenai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal — quick capacity alignment call

Hi Olivia / Hannah,

HavenAI's Dedicated cluster renewal is coming up in July and before we lock terms I wanted to align on capacity needs for the new term. From our side we see sustained 68% average GPU utilization across the A100 pool in May with peak 92% during batch retraining windows. That pattern suggests you are bumping up against steady-state headroom for the MPT-heavy inference traffic you mentioned in April.

Quick asks:
- Can you share any planned product launches or PoCs between Jul–Sep that would increase peak load?
- Do you prefer a one-time tranche add (x GPUs now + x at midpoint) or a single permanent add for the renewal?

I can put together a usage-driven proposal (delta GPUs, cost delta, lead-time) once we confirm target SLOs. Are you available for a 30-min sync next week?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — quick capacity alignment call

Thanks Aditya — and hi Hannah.

Quick context from our side:
- Product roadmap: two feature launches in August (increased request volume) and a month-long marketing trial in September expected to double inference QPS for a subset of customers.
- Current cluster: 32x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved via Redwood Dedicated.
- May utilization snapshot (attached): avg 68% utilization, median seq length 1.2k tokens, tail 3k tokens; KV cache hit ~14%.
- Wish: avoid user-visible latency degradation during the trial while keeping cost predictable.

Our initial ask: +8 GPUs at renewal start (Jul 1) with option to add another +4 mid-term if the September trial verifies load. Lead time for procurement is flexible but we need confirmation by Jun 15 to guarantee delivery window.

Attaching: usage_report_May2026.xlsx (contains per-model token breakdown and daily peak graphs).

Olivia Barnes
Head of Platform Engineering — HavenAI
olivia@havenai.com | +1 617-555-0199

Date: 2026-05-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Re: Upcoming renewal — quick capacity alignment call

Team — forwarding HavenAI's ask and the usage report. Summary notes after a quick read:
- Baseline: 32x GPUs today; May avg util 68% with short high peaks.
- Customer asks: +8 GPUs at renewal (Jul 1) + optional +4 by Sep after trial. Decision deadline Jun 15 for delivery window.

Options I think we should consider (tradeoffs in parentheses):
1) Permanent add 8 GPUs at renewal (simpler forecasting, higher committed revenue).
2) 6 GPUs permanent + 2 GPUs burst/burstable pool (lower commit, preserves headroom for spikes).
3) No permanent bump; offer 8 GPU short-term tranche for Sep trial only (risk of latency now).

Operational constraints: procurement lead time for new hosts is ~3–5 weeks once order is placed; a mixed-sku plan (A100 + L40s) could save ~12% on unit cost but we'd need compatibility checks for their quantized pipeline.

Recommendations: propose option (2) as a middle ground and offer a one-time renewal credit of 10% applied to the tranche-add cost to incentivize commit. I've attached a draft capacity plan (proposed_capacity_plan_HVN-3482.pdf) with baseline math and cost delta.

Ask: Aditya — can you confirm whether pricing flexibility exists for a 10% one-time credit and whether we can guarantee the +2 burst capacity for Sep? Rishi — please sanity-check the lead-time and mixed-sku compatibility. Monica / Dev — anything to add on rollout automation and KV cache migration notes?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

Attachments: proposed_capacity_plan_HVN-3482.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-02T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Re: Upcoming renewal — quick capacity alignment call

Hannah — quick answers:
- Pricing: we can offer a one-time 10% credit on the tranche-add line item for renewals; finance sign-off in principle for HVN-3482 (deal desk queue).
- Burst capacity: we can guarantee a +2 burst pool (best-effort SLAs) if we reserve a small on-demand buffer in their Dedicated pool; I'll get exact wording from infra.
- Lead time: confirmed 3–5 weeks; ordering by Jun 15 still hits Jul 1 start if provisioning schedule holds.

I'll update HubSpot and attach the finance-approved line item to the deal (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3482). If everyone is aligned I'll send a customer-facing proposal and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Cheers,
Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Renewal proposal: usage-driven capacity add (HVN-3482)

Olivia / Jake / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turn on numbers. Per our internal alignment, here is the proposed renewal approach for the July 1 start date:

Summary (final proposal)
- Permanent commit: +6 A100-equivalent GPUs added to Dedicated pool starting Jul 1.
- Burst pool: +2 GPUs available for Sep marketing trial (best-effort reserve).
- Optional mid-term add: +4 GPUs if trial >30% above baseline during Sep (triggered by defined metrics in SOW).
- One-time commercial: 10% credit applied to the tranche-add line for this renewal period.
- Lead time: provisioning ordered by Jun 15 to meet Jul 1 start (3–5 week lead time).

Attachments: HVN-3482_docusign_proposal.pdf (DocuSign), proposed_capacity_plan_HVN-3482.pdf, usage_report_May2026.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Olivia / Procurement: confirm acceptance by Jun 15 so we can place provisioning order.
2) Aditya: send DocuSign for signature (I will attach the SOW appendix with the burst pool metrics).
3) Rishi / Dev: standby for provisioning window; we'll coordinate KV cache warmup and rollout runbook.

Olivia — happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk the plan before sign.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
